info.name: QStash Messages API
info.description:
QStash is a serverless message queue and task scheduling REST API from Upstash that delivers HTTP messages to endpoints reliably without requiring any long-lived connections or infrastructure management.

Contact Support:
 Name: Upstash Support

header.description: Delay message delivery by this duration (e.g. "5m", "1h")
Number of retry attempts on delivery failure (0-5)
Delay expression between retries (supports math functions like pow, sqrt)
URL to receive callback after successful delivery
URL to receive callback on delivery failure after all retries
Manual deduplication ID; duplicate messages within 10 minutes are ignored
Automatically deduplicate based on destination, body, and content headers
Timeout for the delivery request (e.g. "30s")
Unix timestamp before which delivery should not occur
Unique schedule ID; used to create or overwrite a schedule
CRON expression to schedule recurring delivery (e.g. "0 0 * * *")
HTTP method to use when calling the destination (default POST)

variable.description: (Required) Destination URL or URL Group name

request.description: Publish a message to a destination URL or URL Group. QStash will store the message durably and deliver it to the destination with automatic retries on failure.
